CustomField.description: The date the candidate was removed from this training. Set this BEFORE flipping Status to Dropped; the Candidate_Training_Dropped_Cascade flow uses it as the cutoff for cascading status updates on Deliverables/Steps/Sessions. Records dated before this day keep their prior status; on/after this day they roll to Dropped (Steps and Deliverables) or Cancelled (Sessions). Leave blank to default to today.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set before changing Status to Dropped. Drives the cutoff date for cascading updates on the training's deliverables, steps, and sessions. Blank = today.
CustomField.label: Drop Date
